findings.description: check_evidence re-binds referenced docs/checks/*.json artifacts only for phases 23-25, and check_phase.py:862 records checkpoint_bindings only for those phases. Phase 26's command set references docs/checks/phase-26-private-material.json (check_phase.py:321), which lives under the fingerprint-excluded docs/checks/ prefix (review_phase.py:15). The passing report therefore carries no digest of the privacy receipt it consumed, so that receipt can change after the run without any review-time detection. The receipt in this attempt is genuine (checkedAt 23:35:52, sourceSha256 1b95fd90, headCommit d62998f, 2229 files, 0 matches), so this is a binding gap rather than a false claim.

findings.description: `git diff --check 578f2e6..HEAD` applies whitespace hygiene to the immutable pinned upstream bytes under contracts/sources/typescript-0.35.0/** with no `:(exclude)` pathspec, unlike phases 21-25 which exclude vendor YAML. test_management_phases.py:123 only iterates range(21,26), so phase 26's hygiene command is outside that guarantee.
